offering_description.value: Develops and manufactures diagnostic tests, instruments, reagents and software for life science research, drug discovery and clinical diagnostics. Sells to pharmaceutical and biotech companies, academic labs, hospitals and diagnostic labs. Also provides related services such as service contracts and testing.

primary_products.value: diagnostic assays and reagents; imaging and detection instruments; newborn and reproductive health screening tests; immunodiagnostic kits; lab software and informatics

primary_services.value: instrument maintenance and service contracts; clinical testing services; laboratory informatics and analytics; custom assay development

customer_segment.value: B2B: pharmaceutical and biotech companies, academic and research labs, diagnostic laboratories, hospitals; B2G: public health agencies and government-funded newborn screening programs

end_markets.value: life science research; drug discovery; clinical diagnostics; newborn and reproductive health; biopharma

revenue_model.value: product sales: instruments, consumable reagents, assay kits; service fees: instrument service contracts, testing and lab services; subscription: software and informatics platform subscriptions

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes instruments, reagents and diagnostic kits, sold to labs, researchers and healthcare providers; software / platform: analytics and informatics software for research and diagnostic labs; service provider: clinical testing and instrument servicing for labs and clinics
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: Americas, Europe, Asia-Pacific including China, and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: diagnostics and life science research tools: assays, reagents, instruments and software

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales force selling to pharma, biotech, academic and clinical labs; distributors / dealers: regional distributors in markets without direct presence; online: e-commerce ordering of reagents and consumables

regulatory_exposure.value: high: in vitro diagnostics need FDA clearance, CE marking and similar approvals, clinical labs under CLIA
